message.content:
Is it easier to urbanize a jungle or to urbanize a desert?
Urbanizing a desert is simpler because flat terrain speeds roadwork quickly.
The major cost is water, so pipelines and desalination need planning.
Jungle sites have water, but dense canopy and pests slow many projects.
Clearing vegetation also creates erosion, disease, and additional local drainage problems.
With good engineering, either environment can host a reasonably compact city.
A giraffe could not live there, but desert areas are usually easier urban planning choices.
